mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gate_reports (chapter_id, scene_id, gate_type, round, passed, result) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{sceneId}, #{gateType}, #{round}, #{passed}, #{resultJson}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT result::text FROM gate_reports WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND gate_type='mechanical' AND passed=false ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT result::text FROM gate_reports WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND scene_id=#{sceneId} AND passed=false ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT passed, create_time, result::text FROM gate_reports WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND scene_id IS NULL AND gate_type='mechanical' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT passed, create_time, result::text FROM gate_reports WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND scene_id IS NULL AND gate_type='ai_review' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, chapter_id, scene_id, gate_type, round, passed, result::text AS result, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM gate_reports WHERE chapter_id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false ORDER BY id ASC
